updates.detailed_summary_zh: 加密货币交易所Kraken的母公司Payward正在探索在海外成为一家全能银行，业务范围将扩展至银行、贷款和资产管理，未来还可能涉及抵押贷款。 此举标志着加密货币行业进一步机构化，主要参与者正进军传统金融服务领域。这也可能为其他寻求在海外获得银行牌照的加密公司开创先例，模糊加密货币与传统银行之间的界限。 目前该探索仍处于战略阶段，尚未获得监管最终批准，也不会产生直接影响。该银行将在美国以外运营，但具体司法管辖区尚未披露。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Payward, the parent company of crypto exchange Kraken, is exploring becoming a full bank outside the US, expanding into banking, lending, and asset management, with mortgages a future possibility. This move signals further institutionalization of the crypto industry as major players push into traditional financial services. It could also set a precedent for other crypto firms seeking banking licenses abroad, blurring the line between crypto and conventional banking. The exploration is at a strategic stage, with no regulatory finality or immediate market impact. The bank would operate outside the US, though specific jurisdictions have not been disclosed.
